(Currently Amended) Claim 7 (Previously Presented): A method for preventing or treating glaucoma wherein (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof are administered to a subject in need of preventing or treating glaucoma.

(Currently Amended) Claim 8 (Previously Presented): A method for preventing or treating ocular hypertension wherein (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof are administered to a subject in need of preventing or treating ocular hypertension.
